meta.title: The Ninth | apiobuild
meta.description: Lulu and Meiling are both Asian American small business builders. Together, they want to share behind-the-scenes stories of other Asian Americans building something they're proud of — a local coffee shop, a restaurant passed down from their parents, a tech product, a community — and beyond.

meta.title: Deals | What's the Tea
meta.description: Free plans and free trials that help small business owners get going: selling, money, marketing and AI tools, picked by What's the Tea.

deals.title: Free tools for builders
deals.body: Free plans and trials we'd point any small business owner to. No codes needed.
deals.note: We're not affiliated with these companies and don't earn anything from them. Offers and terms are set by each company and can change, so check their page before you sign up. Last checked September 2026.

join.body: Know a deal we should add? Tell us in the community.
join.label: Join the Community

items.name: Google Business Profile
items.details: List your business on Google Search and Maps, with photos, reviews and updates, at no cost.

items.name: Square
items.details: Free POS app, invoicing, booking and an online site. You only pay per payment: 2.6% + 15¢ in person, 3.3% + 30¢ online.

items.name: Shopify
items.details: Start your online store with no credit card for the trial, then $1 a month for your first 3 months.

items.name: Wave
items.details: Unlimited invoices, estimates and bookkeeping. Card payments cost 2.9% + 60¢, and bank auto-import needs the paid plan.

items.name: Mercury
items.details: Business checking and savings with no minimum balance or monthly fees, plus free domestic ACH and wires.

items.name: Mailchimp
items.details: Email marketing for up to 250 contacts and 500 sends a month.

items.name: HubSpot
items.details: Keep track of customers and leads, free for up to 2 users and 1,000 contacts, with no time limit.

items.name: Claude
items.details: Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, research and working through files on web, desktop and mobile, with usage limits.

items.name: Granola
items.details: AI meeting notes with no daily limit. The free app shows notes from the last 30 days.

items.name: Notion
items.details: Docs, databases, forms and a simple web page, with 5 MB uploads and 7 days of page history.

items.name: Calendly
items.details: A booking page for one-on-one appointments, with one event type and one connected calendar.

items.name: Wix
items.details: Build and host a site with templates for free. It shows Wix branding, and a custom domain needs a paid plan.

hero.eyebrow: Podcast | Stories from Asian American builders
hero.title: The Ninth
hero.body: Lulu and Meiling are both Asian American small business builders. Together, they want to share behind-the-scenes stories of other Asian Americans building something they're proud of — a local coffee shop, a restaurant passed down from their parents, a tech product, a community — and beyond.

bands.title: Why do they build?
bands.body: Giving up the comfort and stability of a 9-5, paychecks, health insurance, a prestigious job title. In exchange for working 24/7, doing anything and everything, and unsolicited comments from family and friends. Listen to stories of builders.

bands.title: Join the conversation. Ask anything.
bands.body: A new episode is released every Tuesday. Join the live discussion, bring your questions. Meet other builders, and talk about the not-so-pretty things no one talks about.

people.name: Lulu
people.bio: Founder, ex Reddit, Square. Building Bagel², software for small businesses.

people.name: Meiling
people.bio: Meiling and her husband founded Catfight Coffee, an artisan coffee brand that blends punk rock, Halloween and vintage style. You can find them online, at the store in Boonton, NJ, and at pop-up events across the US.

bands.title: Want to hear someone's story?
bands.body: Invite them to the conversation. No win is too small and no story is too messy. We want to hear it all. If that's you or someone you know, tell us.
